teaser.en: Its leaves are perfectly round, like strands of spaghetti waving under the sea.
teaser.sw: Majani yake ni ya mviringo kamili, kama nyuzi za tambi zinazopepea chini ya bahari.

summary.en: Noodle seagrass is a flowering plant of shallow subtidal sand, easy to know by its round, spaghetti-like leaves. Like other seagrasses, its meadows shelter the fish and octopus that coastal fishers rely on.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari ya tambi (*noodle seagrass*) ni mmea unaotoa maua wa mchanga usio na kina ulio chini ya maji kupwa, na ni rahisi kuitambua kwa majani yake ya mviringo kama tambi. Kama nyasi bahari nyingine, mbuga zake huwahifadhi samaki na pweza ambao wavuvi wa pwani wanawategemea.

about.en: Noodle seagrass is a true flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea. Unlike most seagrasses, which have flat leaves, its leaves are round in cross-section, thin and smooth like strands of spaghetti or noodles. They grow in tufts from creeping stems in the sand and can form dense, waving meadows.
about.sw: Nyasi bahari ya tambi ni mmea halisi unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini. Tofauti na nyasi bahari nyingi, zenye majani bapa, majani yake ni ya mviringo yakikatwa, membamba na laini kama nyuzi za tambi. Huota kama mashungi kutoka kwenye mashina yanayotambaa mchangani na yanaweza kuunda mbuga zilizosongamana zinazopepea.

where.en: It grows on shallow subtidal sand, just below the lowest tides, so it is usually covered by water. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. Snorkellers in the lagoons see it best, its noodle-like leaves drifting in the current.
where.sw: Huota kwenye mchanga usio na kina ulio chini kidogo ya maji kupwa kabisa, hivyo kwa kawaida hufunikwa na maji. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Wanaopiga mbizi kwa kutumia mrija katika mahori ndio huiona vizuri zaidi, majani yake kama tambi yakielea katika mkondo.

uses.en: Its meadows are habitat for the rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on. The meadows also trap sediment and help to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga zake ni makazi ya tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea. Mbuga hizo pia hunasa mashapo na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili speakers usually call sea plants in general *mwani*. In English it is noodle seagrass, and its scientific name is *Syringodium isoetifolium*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kwa kawaida huita mimea ya baharini kwa jumla *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *noodle seagrass*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Syringodium isoetifolium*.

conservation.en: The seagrass meadows of Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni are feeding grounds for dugongs, green turtles and rabbitfish, and nurseries for young fish.
conservation.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari za Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni malisho ya nguva, kasa na tafi, na malezi ya samaki wachanga.

reason.sw: Familia moja, katika maji yenye kina zaidi
